headline: Berm and Hollow Surge as Mercy Goes Quiet
war_summary: Since the afternoon edition the wires have quickened at three points while the late leader has gone quiet. Palantine Berm counts five changes in two hours and sixty-one in the day about Vendett, Windburn Landing and the Pippeli Stones, holding four Warden to three Colonial, and Marban Hollow counts eight in two hours and thirty-five in the day centered on Checkpoint Bua with thirty-three entries, standing two Warden, three Colonial and three neutral. Weathered Expanse reports six in two hours and twenty-nine in the day at Crow's Nest, Wightwalk and Necropolis, holding six Warden, one Colonial and two neutral amid day losses above eleven thousand Colonial and near thirteen thousand Warden. Linn Mercy, busiest at last filing, shows no change in two hours against twenty-four in the day at Outwich Ranch and Lathair for eight Colonial and three neutral, while Stonecradle adds three late changes and nine in the day at the Dais and Trammel Pool and Gutter three late and eight in the day at Suojus and Lost Kaivo, with Nevish Line and Mooring County silent in recent hours.
